markings: U.S. ARMY / PATRIOT / MIM-104 / UNITED STATES; original decorative US flag, not an exact official production stencil
launcher_pose: Mount coordinates are defined in the unrotated truck model. Parent the projectile to Launcher_Pitch or apply its visual transform before showing it.
integration: Cosmetic projectile mesh only. Connect spawn, velocity, targeting, inventory, collision, damage and multiplayer in the Minecraft mod. Geometry does not implement real missile systems.
effects: Exhaust_Anchor can locate existing mod flame/smoke particles. Particle textures and sounds are not included.
scope: Original exterior game art inspired by public Patriot photographs. Game proportions fitted to the existing MPL-01 containers, not an exact engineering reconstruction.
